Changes.note: Selecting an application opens the applicant’s e-mail address and phone, and that look is written to the audit log; when the page opens and when an application is answered, the next one is selected by itself. “Köşkü aç” first opens a köşk with the application’s name and summary, making the applicant its köşk nazımı (the application’s field is not carried over); unless “Listelerde gösterme” is ticked, the köşk shows in Keşfet at once. The application is then accepted and the applicant notified; if the acceptance cannot be saved, the köşk just opened stays open. “Reddet” sends the reason to the applicant’s notifications. An answer is given once and cannot be taken back here; an opened köşk only goes out of sight by being hidden.
